views.title: Alfred builds Alfred
views.caption: Kevin asks Alfred for a fix by voice, the engine queues a task, a Claude worker on his laptop builds and tests it on a branch and asks "Ship it?"; a yes is a new task that merges, deploys the engine and publishes a phone release, which the phone verifies and offers to install.

views.title: A Claude task's statuses
views.caption: A task Alfred hands to a Claude worker on Kevin's laptop is queued, claimed and run, and finishes done, failed, needs_confirmation or cancelled. A yes to "Ship it?" is a new child task, so needs_confirmation is terminal.

views.title: Containers and deployment
views.caption: One engine image runs two ways on Google Cloud, a Cloud Run service for requests and a Cloud Run job that Cloud Scheduler starts once per line of deploy/crontab, both on Supabase Postgres. The phone keeps a Room replica and an outbox; the Claude worker polls the engine from Kevin's laptop.

nodes.label: Android app Room replica + outbox polls /api/changes
React SPA / PWA in the browser
Cloud Run service: legion gunicorn + Django API, /mcp and the built SPA
Cloud Scheduler one entry per crontab line
Cloud Run job: legion-worker manage.py task
GCS bucket legion-apk APKs, private, signed links

Schedules, UTC push_dispatch every 5 min canvas_poll, heartbeat every 30 min morning_brief, prune_demo_visitors hourly plaid_sync every 3 h, drive_statements every 6 h backup_nightly, claude_session_prune, finance_snapshots, fx_rates daily

views.title: LEGION in context
views.caption: Three kinds of people reach LEGION through four clients. Every client talks to one Django engine over HTTPS; Gemini is called directly by the phone and head unit on the household's key, and by the browser with a one-use token the engine mints.

nodes.label: Android phone app Alfred, Room replica
React web app and the /try demo
Gemini REST Live token mint, statement PDFs, web search

views.title: The ingestion gate
views.caption: A bank's own Plaid feed is stored as fact with no gate. A statement meets a registered parser first, a CSV never reaches Gemini, and a PDF the model reads needs all three anchors; every document must reconcile to its own printed figures exactly or it is quarantined whole, and the anchors are kept beside the rows.

nodes.label: Statement file Drive folder, every 6 h
Stored as fact, no gate provenance BANK_API replaces file rows from its first date
Gemini reads the PDF on the household key
Printed total, opening and closing balance all stated?
Lines sum to the printed total, closing minus opening equals the sum?
Items, tax and other sum to the printed total?
Commit DETERMINISTIC or LLM_RECONCILED anchors kept in their own columns
Quarantine the whole document reason in words, nothing written

views.title: A recruiter's visit, invite code to deletion
views.caption: The invite code buys a two-hour visit with its own freshly seeded demo household; every voice session is a one-use, locked Gemini Live token, every tool call is fenced by the recruiter allowlist, and an hourly job deletes the whole household once the visit expires.

views.title: One voice turn on the phone
views.caption: The wake word opens a Gemini Live session; on-device end-of-turn detection decides when the person has finished; a question for the engine goes through a small sub-agent over /mcp, its card is drawn on the phone, and the answer goes back to Gemini, which speaks it.

nodes.label: Wake word: VAD, keyword spotter, Vosk check
End of turn: Silero VAD + Smart Turn

views.title: The knowledge layer
views.caption: Each question has one place to answer it. CLAUDE.md holds the rules, MEMORY.md the dated state, the ADRs what binds now and decisions.md what happened when; tickets' frontmatter generates the board and the public wiki, so they cannot drift. Agent auto-memory lives outside the repo.

nodes.label: memory/MEMORY.md the state, every line dated
memory/library/lessons.md mistakes, until they become rules
Tickets: .scratch maps status in YAML frontmatter
obsidian_sync.py + pending_wiki.py run by the commit hook

views.title: The agentic coding loop
views.caption: Kevin's idea is grilled into rulings, charted as a map of tickets with ADRs, built by agents in parallel in their own git worktrees, held at the real build and test gates, merged to dev and main, and shipped as an engine deploy or an over-the-air phone release; a mistake found on the way becomes a lesson.

nodes.label: Grilling grillme, one question at a time
Map and tickets .scratch/effort/map.md + issues/ a build ticket per resolved decision
Parallel agents one git worktree each feat/ or fix/ branch off dev
Real build and suites: compileDebugKotlin + JVM tests pytest, tsc -b, detekt baseline docs_check, decision_debt hook screenshots
Ticket status: built owes a run on the real phone
Merge to dev then dev to main
Phone release release_apk.py, over the air
Lesson in lessons.md graduates into a rule or a check

views.title: Who does what
views.caption: Kevin rules and approves. The orchestrator session plans, dispatches by default and reviews, relaying each agent's verification tags unchanged. Five subagent seats build, audit, run the phone, search and design in their own worktrees. The Claude worker on the Alienware takes Alfred's tasks by voice. Hooks hold the line in both places.

nodes.label: Kevin sets the destination, rules, approves
Orchestrator main Claude Code session plans, dispatches, reviews, relays tags
builder writes code to the spec
Claude worker on the Alienware takes Alfred's tasks, asks Ship it?
Repo hooks, before tool calls commit: regenerate board, wiki, ADR index block destructive commands, generated files warn: Kotlin over 1000 lines, Room changes
asklist_hook on the worker push, deploy, publish only via ship.py

views.title: One change, from Kevin's ask to his phone
views.caption: The budget bar change of 2026-11-05. Kevin asked to see what he had spent against what was left; an agent built it on a branch with the suites and screenshots, Kevin corrected it twice, the branch merged to dev and main, his own command deployed the engine and published the release, and the phone asked before it installed.
